# Shrimprium

> Shrimprium is a free pixel-art shrimp aquarium simulator where the ecosystem actually runs. You raise and breed shrimp in a glass tank and watch plants, microbes, and water chemistry turn it into a living world. Playable in any web browser and as an iOS/Android app.

Shrimprium is a relaxing, single-player aquarium simulation game. Unlike a static virtual fish tank, its ecosystem is genuinely alive and keeps simulating whether or not you are watching: plants grow, microbes process waste, and the water chemistry (nitrogen cycle, pH, dissolved oxygen) shifts in real time. It is free to play, works offline as a Progressive Web App, and saves automatically.

## What you do

- Raise, feed, and breed shrimp in a tank that stays alive on its own.
- Manage living water chemistry: the nitrogen cycle, pH, and dissolved oxygen.
- Control temperature with heaters, coolers, and air pumps.
- Decorate your tank and unlock new species through quests and levels.
- Selectively breed new shrimp via a genetics system (color, pattern, and transparency inheritance with mutation).
- Manage up to four tanks on a shelf system.
- Earn pocket money four times a day — healthier shrimp earn bigger rewards.

## Platforms and access

- Web: play instantly in a modern browser at https://play.shrimprium.com/ (start as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google).
- Mobile: available as iOS and Android apps.
- Offline: installable Progressive Web App with automatic local saves.
- Price: free to play.
